FIVE VISUALISATION TECHNIQUES TO MASTER YOUR MIND, BUILD CONFIDENCE AND ENHANCE PERFORMANCE

We all have habits and behaviours that hold us back from reaching our fullest potential. In VISUALISE, the very first book of its kind on visualisation, Maya Raichoora shows you how to harness the power of visualisation and retrain your brain so you can take control of the way you think, feel and perform, once and for all.

Drawing on the latest neuroscience, theory, Maya's personal experience and compelling case studies, VISUALISE presents five tangible and easy-to-implement visualisation techniques that will help you boost your productivity, achieve your goals and create the best version of yourself. The five techniques are:

1. Outcome visualisation
2. Process visualisation
3. Creative visualisation
4. Negative visualisation
5. Explorative visualisation

'The best book you’ll ever read on visualisation.'
- Robin Sharma, #1 worldwide bestselling author of The Wealth Money Can’t Buy and The 5AM Club

‘Distilling the art of mental fitness and drawing on neuroscience, this is a timeless and essential read for anyone wanting to supercharge their mindset and performance’
- Dr Tara Swart, neuroscientist and bestselling author of The Source

'Maya shows us how visualisation works, why it works and importantly, how to make it work for you to make real and lasting changes to how you feel, your confidence and self-belief. She also shows how you can use visualisation to be more successful in your life. It's an absolute game-changer of a book.'
- Dr David R Hamilton, author of The Joy of Actually Giving a F*ck

About the Author

Maya Raichoora is one of the UK's leading mental fitness and visualization experts. She is an award-winning entrepreneur, founder and CEO of Remap Mental Fitness. Day to day she works with global brands such as Nike, Gymshark, Asics, Amex and Lego. As a two times TEDx speaker and public figure, her story and expertise has the power to inspire, empower and educate the masses. She lives in London.

    As a somewhat novice to the practice of visualisation I am already hooked on Maya’s new book “Visualise”. It’s extremely well written and user friendly. Maya really brings to life the power of visualisation and how it can rewire the brain. The Chapters are split into three Parts which are Awareness, Education & Intelligence. The book is jam packed with information and Maya introduces different theories and concepts throughout. She’s skilled at breaking down her depth of knowledge in an accessible and digestible manner for the reader. I loved Part 2 of the book where Maya sets out the five different Visualisation Techniques and provides a guided Visualisation Practice (complete with recommended music) for each one. I really enjoyed discovering more about Maya’s own journey and life experiences throughout the book and learning how high performers utilise the tool of visualisation in order to achieve success in their field. This book is an absolute must read for anyone who wants to learn more about mental fitness and visualisation and make profound change in their life. Maya is breath of fresh air in the personal development space and I love her straight talking no nonsense approach. One of my fave reads so far this year.. thank you Maya for your amazing work!! 🌟🌟🌟

    Visualize by Maya is THE best book I have read for visualising. I have been reading many books and watching countless videos related to mentally rehearsing my future self and creating my destiny from Dr. Joe Dispenza to Gabby Bernstein. But what I struggled with was truly feeling the emotions and gratitude like I already have everything I desired and that is the main ingredient. This book by Maya holds the key to all of this. She has put in so much effort to include the smallest details and exercises we can do to make this happen with lots of visualization techniques broken down step by step as well as a 30 day exercise we can do with a simple goal to make sure it's practical. She also explains clearly the difference between meditation, manifestation and visualization which is so crucial. I do believe that if we follow the guidance in this book diligently with discipline, we can achieve our goals and transform our lives.
